headline_item.title_zh: 澳大利亚通过《数字注意义务法》
headline_item.title_en: Australia passes the Digital Duty of Care Act, an online safety law that exposes Big Tech to multibillion-dollar fines for failing to prevent foreseeable harms (Rod McGuirk/Associated Press)
headline_item.author: Associated Press
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 澳大利亚立法要求大型科技公司预防预见性在线伤害，违规者最高可被罚全球营收的5%，该法案因自由裁量权争议引发言论审查担忧
headline_item.event_summary_en: The Australian Parliament has passed the Digital Duty of Care Act, legally mandating that Big Tech companies take proactive measures to prevent foreseeable online harms. Backed by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's government, the legislation allows for fines of up to 5% of global revenue, though it faces intense criticism over potential political censorship and free speech concerns.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯（澳大利亚总理）、澳大利亚议会：通过《数字注意义务法》，对科技巨头施加严苛的安全预防义务及重额罚款
【起因与机理】旨在应对数字环境下的在线伤害及强化对儿童和社会的保护责任
【关键数据与实测】违规平台最高面临全球营业额5%的罚款，监管逻辑对标欧盟《数字服务法案》。
【各方立场与态度】反对派质疑其赋予政府过大行政权力，担忧未来成为政治审查的工具。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Anthony Albanese (Prime Minister of Australia), Australian Parliament (Australian legislative assembly): Passed the Digital Duty of Care Act imposing strict safety obligations and heavy fines on Big Tech
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To address online harms and enhance protection for children and society
[Key Metrics] Maximum fines set at 5% of global revenue, aligning with EU Digital Services Act standards.
[Official Stance & Demand] Opposition critiques warn of potential overreach and its use as a tool for political censorship.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 该法案标志着监管范式从“事后追责”向“风险前置”的本质跃迁，赋予了监管机构极大的合规定义权。随着欧盟、英国与澳洲在这一领域形成监管合围，跨国科技公司将不得不将“合规算法设计”前置于产品开发周期，以降低法律不确定性带来的巨额资本减记风险。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The Act represents a fundamental shift in regulatory paradigms from ex-post liability to proactive ex-ante risk management, granting regulators significant discretion in defining 'harm.' With similar frameworks in the EU and UK, Big Tech must now integrate compliance-by-design into their product development lifecycles to mitigate legal risks.

headlines.title_zh: AI加剧美国公共记录查询压力
headlines.title_en: AI is straining America’s open records systems
headlines.author: Rachel Courtland
headlines.event_summary_zh: AI自动化请求推高了公共记录系统的数据挖掘频率，导致地方机构在处理负担与透明度之间陷入监管困境
headlines.event_summary_en: AI-powered automation is triggering a surge in public records requests across the U.S., forcing local agencies to handle significantly increased volume and scope. This influx has strained the limited resources of town and state offices, leading some jurisdictions to consider legislative changes to limit transparency requirements, potentially hindering open government.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国各级地方政府机构、AI数据挖掘初创企业在美国各州地方行政单位：公共记录查询系统不堪重负，机构面临激增的自动化请求
【起因与机理】AI降低了 opposition research 及数据信号挖掘的边际成本
【调查与监管诉求】AI自动化极大降低了数据爬取的边际成本，导致公共记录查询量呈双位数增长。
【行业影响与走向】部分地区开始立法收紧查询门槛，潜在影响公民监督权力与行政透明度。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Local government agencies, AI-backed data mining startups (U.S. municipal government offices): Public records systems are struggling with an surge of automated inquiries
[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI has lowered the marginal cost of data mining and opposition research
[Key Metrics] Pursuit, backed by investors including Bill Gurley and Jack Altman, has raised $25.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Legislative moves to tighten access thresholds may negatively impact public oversight and governmental transparency.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI正在将公共记录这一传统行政公权，异化为低成本的商业信号挖掘工具，这直接冲击了《信息自由法》（FOIA）的平衡基石。未来监管的焦点将从“是否公开”转向“公开的数据读取速率与授权范畴”，地方机构数字化基础设施的滞后将成为限制政务透明度的关键技术瓶颈。
headlines.industry_impact_en: AI is transforming public records from administrative tools into low-cost commercial signal harvesting, destabilizing the foundations of FOIA. The regulatory focus will shift toward governing data access rates and intent, while the technical limitations of legacy government infrastructure emerge as a major bottleneck to transparency.
